richiami.difetto: It has been identified that due to a quality issue with the 8mm thread 1.25 pinch bolt the bolt may become loose causing twisting of the suspension front PB 65 wishbone rear bush.
richiami.modello: Front Wishbone Rear Bush - Part No: PB65 , Front Wishbone Rear Bush - Part No: PB65
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the torque of the bolt checked and if necessary the subject front wishbone rear bush replaced.
richiami.titolo: FRONT SUSPENSION WISHBONE REAR BUSH STEADY BOLT MAY WORK LOOSE
